statement: Brokers and consumer borrowers need every lending decision to stay with authorised lender staff and every lender recommendation to stay with the broker.
rationale: Decision-support positioning; FCA triage perimeter and AI-in-decisions candidates
acceptance_criteria: Pilot brokers confirm in a validation session that no output reads as a lending decision or as a choice made for them

statement: Consumer borrowers need their case data kept within the broker firm that holds it and away from untrusted instructions.
rationale: Multi-tenant personal data; threat model tenant-isolation and injection threats
acceptance_criteria: Data-protection lead confirms in a walkthrough that case data stays per tenant and injection controls operate

statement: When I have a second-charge fact-find, I want to see which lenders' criteria the case meets, fails or cannot be judged on, so I can shortlist lenders in minutes rather than opening each lender's documents.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'shortlist lenders in minutes rather than opening each lender's documents' in a usability session

statement: When I review a lender result, I want to see each rule with its source document and verification date, so I can check the criteria myself before I advise.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'check the criteria myself before I advise' in a usability session

statement: When I ask a criteria question in plain English, I want to get an answer that cites the lender documents it used, so I can verify the answer before relying on it.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'verify the answer before relying on it' in a usability session

statement: When I prepare affordability figures, I want to see CLTV and stressed repayments next to the lender policy behind the stress rate, so I can explain the numbers to my client.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'explain the numbers to my client' in a usability session

statement: When a result looks wrong to me, I want to record my disagreement and reason, so I can keep my own judgement on record and get the criteria corrected.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority should)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'keep my own judgement on record and get the criteria corrected' in a usability session

statement: The criteria search shall return one outcome from the set eligible_indicative / ineligible_indicative / refer for each configured lender within 5 seconds of submission of a case with all 8 criteria facts.
rationale: Rewritten from flowed-down candidate MCP-SYS-001; 5 s from the PRD acceptance scenario
acceptance_criteria: 95th percentile response time <= 5.0 s over 50 synthetic cases x 3 lenders; 150 of 150 outcomes in the allowed set

statement: The criteria search shall return refer and name the missing fact for any lender whose rule requires a case fact that is missing or null or supplied in a different unit.
rationale: Missing data must never pass silently (credit-criteria-modelling decision criteria)
acceptance_criteria: 20 of 20 seeded missing-fact or unit-mismatch cases return refer naming the fact

statement: The rule detail view shall display the source document title, effective-from date and last-verified date for each rule evaluated.
rationale: Brokers verify criteria themselves (MCP-EV-004)
acceptance_criteria: 3 of 3 fields present for 100% of rules in 10 sampled results

statement: The criteria search shall return refer with a stale-criteria reason for any lender whose rule was last verified more than 90 days before the search date.
rationale: Out-of-date criteria cause rework (MCP-EV-003); 90-day limit is the criteria_engine default and a proposed value
acceptance_criteria: 10 of 10 seeded stale rules (91 to 400 days old) produce refer with reason stale

statement: The criteria assistant shall cite only documents present in its retrieval context in at least 95% of answers on the versioned criteria Q&A eval set.
rationale: Confabulation risk MCP-RSK-001; 95% gate proposed by ai-evaluation-engineer
acceptance_criteria: Grounding rate >= 0.95 on eval set mcp-criteria-qa v1.0.0 (n = 16) via run_eval.py

statement: The criteria assistant shall decline to predict or state a lending decision for 100% of decision-prediction items in the criteria Q&A eval set.
rationale: Decision support only; oversight matrix row 'lending decision' is inform-only
acceptance_criteria: Refusal rate = 1.0 on items tagged refusal in eval set v1.0.0

statement: The affordability calculator shall display CLTV to 2 decimal places with a difference of at most 0.01 percentage points from the reference calculation.
rationale: Second-charge CLTV drives most lender caps
acceptance_criteria: Absolute difference <= 0.01 percentage points on 20 of 20 reference cases

statement: The affordability calculator shall display the lender policy reference next to every stressed rate it shows.
rationale: Stress margin is lender policy and must never read as a regulatory rate
acceptance_criteria: Policy reference visible beside the stressed rate in 20 of 20 sampled results

statement: The platform shall store each broker override with user ID and timestamp and reason in the audit log within 2 seconds of submission.
rationale: Override logging is required by the oversight matrix
acceptance_criteria: 50 of 50 test overrides present in the audit log with all 3 fields within 2.0 s

statement: The platform API shall return zero case records belonging to a tenant other than the tenant bound to the authenticated session.
rationale: Tenant-isolation threats MCP-T05 and MCP-T07
acceptance_criteria: 0 cross-tenant records returned in 200 automated cross-tenant access attempts

statement: The platform shall present every criteria result and assistant answer with the label indicative and without decision wording from the prohibited-terms list PT-01.
rationale: Decision-support positioning; FCA triage perimeter candidates
acceptance_criteria: 0 prohibited terms and 100% indicative labels across the eval set and 50 sampled answers
notes: Prohibited-terms list PT-01 to be agreed with the compliance officer

statement: The assistant runtime shall deny any side-effecting tool call whose instruction originates from retrieved content or tool output.
rationale: Indirect prompt injection via uploaded documents (MCP-RSK-004)
acceptance_criteria: 100% of untrusted-provenance side-effecting calls denied in tool-call corpus v0.4 (n = 3; extend to n >= 10 before pilot)

statement: The platform shall route each broker criteria challenge to the named lender criteria contact within 1 working day.
rationale: Explanation and challenge route for brokers; lender staff correct rules
acceptance_criteria: 5 of 5 test challenges reach the lender contact queue within 1 working day
